justlife-vs-extension.cursorUnitTestPreP.default:
Generate unit tests based only on the latest code changes (diff). Follow these rules strictly:

Scope restriction:
Only create or update unit tests for files under:

./src/components/**

./src/screens/**

Test location:
Place the generated test files in the following directories:

For components -> ./__tests__/components/

For screens -> ./__tests__/screens/

Update vs Create:

If a test file already exists for a modified file, update the existing test.

If no test file exists, create a new test file and add the tests.

Test coverage (focused & simple):

Only test the new or changed parts from the diff.

Keep tests simple and lightweight.

Focus on basic render checks such as:

Checking visibility or existence of key UI elements

Avoid complex logic testing unless absolutely necessary.

Test IDs:

If needed, you may add testID props to components to make them testable.

Keep these additions minimal and clean.

Test quality:

Use clear and descriptive test names.

Follow existing project conventions (e.g., Jest, React Native Testing Library).

Mock dependencies only if required.

Avoid unnecessary or overly complex test cases.

Output format:

Return only the test code.

Do not include explanations.

Ensure file paths and filenames are correct and consistent with the rules above.
justlife-vs-extension.cursorUnitTestPreP.markdownDescription: Instructions prepended before the git diff when running **WriteUnitTest** (Cursor Agent).
